captions.detailed: A compact, modern bread maker with a light gray, boxy body and rounded vertical edges. It features a rear-hinged rectangular lid on top, a side-mounted control panel with a black circular dial and two square push buttons, and a small square front release plunger. The internal baking chamber is designed to hold a loaf pan and includes a small central kneading paddle.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact bread maker with a boxy light gray body, a rear-hinged rectangular lid, a front-facing square release plunger, and a side-mounted control panel containing a rotating black dial and two square buttons. The model should also feature an internal baking chamber with a rotating kneading paddle.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a rounded box shell, then hollow out the top portion to form the baking chamber. Create the lid from a separate filleted box and attach it to the rear of the body with a revolute joint. Model the side control panel with a cylinder for the rotating dial (continuous joint) and small box extrusions for the push buttons (prismatic joints). Add a small square plunger on the front using a prismatic joint, and place a small paddle inside the chamber on a continuous spindle joint.
